notes.title: 85% for Summer Sale and Trading Cards now available!
notes.notes: In honor the Steam Summer Sale we are putting Speed Kills on sale for 85% off, and we have added Steam Trading Cards. The set will feature 5 cards, 5 emoticons, and 3 backgrounds. We hope you enjoy this addition. Thanks for your support.
